[[File:Comfy room.png|thumb|256x256px]] '''Comfort''' level determines the duration of [[Resting Effect]]. Minimum duration is 8 minutes (at 1 comfort), with each additional comfort level stacking 1 minute up to 29 minutes with usual items and 31 minutes with both rare seasonal items. The max comfort normally achievable is 22. If also near a [[Maypole]] or the [[Yule Tree]] 23, and if both then 24. When entering most dungeons (such as [[Burial Chambers]]), a campfire can be constructed to easily gain 3 comfort and a 10-minute [[Rested]] effect. Note that while the player can add more than one furniture item from the categories below, only the one with the highest comfort will influence the comfort rating. == List of comfort sources == Only the highest level item of a category will be used. Items in the same category will not stack with other items in the same category. Items with ''no category'' will stack with different items with ''no category''.
